key_catalyst: IBM’s AI-infrastructure-driven enterprise software spending warning and the resulting broad software selloff
reasoning: IBM’s warning has evolved from an isolated earnings miss into a broad, unresolved repricing of enterprise-software demand as spending shifts toward AI infrastructure. QQQ weakened despite supportive CPI news and strength in AI hardware, while fresh Iran strikes, a naval blockade, elevated oil, and hawkish Fed messaging add overnight gap-down risk. The combined catalysts are escalating rather than fully absorbed.
